_comment: Hazard fix (2026-07-11): the world-spawned environmental fire hazard — the Ember Ring 'braziers' that used to reuse the player-summon totem def. collisionLayer 32 = Viewport ONLY: no damage mask in the game includes that layer, so its body is structurally unkillable and interaction-free (the boss can't burn it, players/companions can't scratch it) while its own aura still burns the player layer (aura masks derive from the caster's faction, not its body layer). collisionMask 16 = Border only (non-blocking, nothing pushes it). maxHealth is moot (unreachable body) but kept sane for direct construction. role structure — its aura is always-on and it acquires nothing, so it authors no aggroRadius (chunk 2); speed 0 keeps it planted. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Brazier
